But the asserted consequence that decides this finding — that the controller calls stop_and_drain() again before restore(), leaving the service masked (deploy-controller.py:2117-2121) — depends on controller source that was not supplied; the callers of stop_and_drain and the restore path are outside the given region. The comment at lines 930-932 also shows capturing the completion baseline at the settled fence is deliberate, and the proposed fix (read the baseline on the forward switch path rather than as a fence prerequisite) is an architectural change to that fence's semantics. Without the controller/caller evidence the harm is unverified and the fix is not clearly the smallest compatible one, so this is unsure rather than valid or invalid.
